readme.markdown:
# agent-trace-auditor-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: agent-trace-auditor. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/agent-trace-auditor

toolsPreview.name: audit_trace
toolsPreview.description: Full audit of an agent execution trace. Detects infinite loops, duplicate calls, tool errors, cost overruns, schema violations, and latency bottlenecks. Returns verdict (pass/review/block), score 0-100, and detailed findings.

toolsPreview.name: quick_verdict
toolsPreview.description: Fast pass/review/block verdict with score and issue counts. Use in CI gates.

toolsPreview.name: diff_traces
toolsPreview.description: Compare two agent traces to detect regressions. Returns score delta, cost delta, added/removed tools, new/resolved issue types.
